svg.title: GroovePuter Cardputer ADV PERFORM keymap — NOTE MODE ON
svg.desc: Color-coded Cardputer ADV keyboard controls for GroovePuter PERFORM mode.
svg.text: Scale-aware live keyboard; note keys stay reserved while transport runs
Transport stopped: QWERTYUIOP + ASDFGHJKL play Synth A with last-note priority.
Transport running: note keys are consumed but emit no NoteOn; I/O/P/K/L cannot reach legacy randomize/BPM commands.
N disables NOTE mode. X releases only the live-owned Synth A note; it does not cut PatternPlayer or Synth B.
